templates.subject: Welcome to Albert — find your next step
templates.title: A good place to begin.
templates.body: Bring a course and a worksheet. Albert will follow your notation and help you reason through one useful next step.
templates.extra: You stay in control of your work. Ask for a question, or request one worked step when you need it.

templates.subject: Your Albert account recovery link
templates.title: Let’s get you back in.
templates.body: We received a request to recover access to your Albert account. Use the secure link below to continue.
templates.extra: This link expires in {{expires_minutes}} minutes. If you did not request it, you can ignore this message.

templates.subject: Your Albert course import is complete
templates.title: Your materials have a next step.
templates.body: The import for {{course_name}} has finished. Ready materials: {{ready_count}}. Materials needing attention: {{failed_count}}.
templates.extra: Review the course context and any materials needing attention before starting practice.

templates.subject: An update on your Albert support request
templates.title: A little help, right here.
templates.extra: Request reference: {{ticket_reference}}. Reply using the support route provided by your actual account service.

sampleFixture.support_message: Thanks for sharing the step that felt unclear. We have added an update to your support request so you can keep moving.
sampleFixture.footer_address: Your configured sender identity and contact details

notes: Replace and escape text values server-side. Validate action URLs against actual service destinations. Recovery tokens and expiration are generated and enforced by the identity service.
Preview destinations use example.invalid and are not functional account links.
These are transactional design templates, not sent emails or a claim of email-client compatibility.
